chapter: Learning drums and Roy Eldridge's band
title: Roy fronts and books the band around West Virginia, Ohio and Pennsylvania
summary: Roy fronted the band, sang like Louis and booked it himself through local organizers.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: So who fronted Roy, then, did --
Did he do his little singing bit?
Oh, yeah, he was singing like Louis, you know.
Well, I never. Fancy that. So how long did that -- well, for instance what territory did you cover?
Well, West Virginia and Ohio and Pennsylvania.
Yeah. Did anybody book the band?
Yeah. Yeah, Roy was doing his own booking.
He was doing his own booking.
Well, that's what we had to do in those days, because we didn't have any agents.
Well, then, but who watched the money?
Roy took care of everything. He had an organizer. You know, like he would make arrangements with an organizer here and there, and there, and there. They would take care of everything.
That was the way it was done in those days.
That's the way it was done.
Well, he could have only been about 23, I guess. Or 24, maybe.
Yeah, like that, because I was -- I was about 17 or 18.
